title: Campaign Research — shared/data.yaml
description: Contract 3 (docs/contracts/campaign-clan.md). Region A (campaign.*), Region C (selection.*), the supplied-material index, the chat intake thread, the middleware-written report and the host's read-only projection of the facts and findings members. Nothing here has a default and no campaign field is required: a field's gate says which state the document cannot reach without it (D4). Every present field is an envelope {value, origin, gate, decision, ...}.

origin.description: extracted: read from supplied material, cites a span. proposed: derived from layer facts, cites fact ids. confirmed: a human accepted or corrected it; re-extraction never overwrites it without asking. stated: a human supplied it directly.

fact_id.description: Opaque fact id. Survives spin-off. Never a path.

decision_id.description: Id of a decision in agent/decision-chain.yaml.

actor.description: An actor as the OS layer's Ctx writes it: human:<user-id>, process:<job-id> or <producer>/<version>.

category.description: A sub-vertical leaf code, <vertical>.<leaf>, from the Planner Research Taxonomy (18 verticals, 108 leaves). The closed enum is taxonomy-versioned and is swapped in for this pattern when the taxonomy file lands; until then the category layer rejects an unknown leaf.

item_key.description: Stable key for an item in a list of prose. Addresses use it: campaign.constraints[<id>]. Never positional.

lens.description: The eight lenses of the Planner Research Taxonomy, in taxonomy order.

span.description: Where in the supplied material an extracted value was read.

quote.description: The span, verbatim. Omitted for budget_band, whose span holds the figure.

ref.description: Entity id, scoped to this agency's database. There is no global brand identity.

name.description: Display name. The handoff mapping sends this, not the ref.

item_provenance.description: Provenance of one list item when a list field's items came from different origins. Keyed by the item's address key.

origin_rules.description: What each origin must carry. Applied to every field envelope and every item_provenance entry.

fact_backed_statement.description: A statement about the audience that rests on pins. The statement never restates a pinned figure — the view renders the figure from the pin.

envelope.description: The shape of every present campaign field. value is typed per field; everything else is provenance. decision is the chain entry that set the current value (GET /history?address= lists the rest).

item_provenance.description: List fields only. Per-item provenance when items came from different origins, keyed by the item's address key (the item itself for codes, slugs and refs; its id for prose). Absent: every item shares the field's origin.

message_id.description: Key of a message in intake.messages. Opaque; ULID-style so a writer's keys sort in creation order.

stage.description: The stages of a start_campaign job, in order. compose_report messages use report.

cite_id.description: A claim's citation: a pin in shared/facts.yaml or a finding in shared/findings.yaml. Never a source, a material or a rejected finding.

question_option.description: One button under a question. With a value it is a candidate: value is the COMPLETE value for the question's field, typed per the field (Contract 3 §2.3), and origin says where the candidate came from, carrying what that origin carries (extracted: source; proposed: fact_ids; stated: the person's own words from an earlier free-text answer). Without a value it is the escape ('None of these', 'Something else'): the view opens the text box and the answer is sent as text.

question.description: What the middleware asked when it could not decide (job.state needs_input). The same object as job.question in the envelope. address is the field the answer settles.

address.description: <doc-id>#campaign.<field> — the field the person's answer writes.

answer.description: The person's answer to a question: an option id, or free text. Exactly one.

intake_message.description: One chat message. role user: written by the view as a human write (by required); may carry the prompt's material_id, attachments and an answer. role agent: written by the middleware's data_patch (job_id and stage required); may carry a question.

material_id.description: User messages: the material this message's text is indexed as (kind prompt, sha256 of the text's UTF-8 bytes).

attachments.description: Materials attached to this message; each is a key of materials.

report_block.description: One block of a report section. claim: a sentence with at least one cite; it states no figure that is not in a cited pin (the view renders figures from pins blocks). pins: the view renders these pins from projection.pins. finding: one finding, labelled derived by the agent unless verified. gap: a selection.gaps entry. contest: a selection.contested entry.

id.description: [gate: created] Stable campaign id. Survives spin-off. Not the manifest id.

name.description: [gate: created] Working name of the campaign.

brand.description: [gate: created] The SUBJECT brand. Never a comparator. Ambiguity blocks; it never defaults.

client_org.description: [gate: created] The agency's client. One client can hold several brands.

categories.description: [gate: research] Category leaves, ranked. A campaign spanning two leaves pins facts from both. Contract values from the brand roster row; left out rather than guessed. Retrieval: one category pair per entry.

markets.description: [gate: research] Markets. Research runs once per market and merges by entity+key+market. Retrieval: one market pair per entry.

problem.description: [gate: brief] The client's problem in the client's words, verbatim. Retrieval.

audience_stated.description: [gate: brief] Who the client says it is for. Retrieval (as audience).

audience.description: [gate: brief] The researched audience. A field backed by pinned facts, origin proposed or confirmed only.

definition.description: Who the research says the audience is, in one or two sentences.

size.description: Size is never a number here — it is the pins that measure it.

synthesis_finding_ids.description: Audience syntheses. Findings until verified; the view labels an unverified one 'derived by the agent'.

competitor_set.description: [gate: none] Comparator brands. Every one is a comparator — public material only. Retrieval: competitors = the names.

success_measures.description: [gate: none] How the client will judge success.

budget_band.description: [gate: brief] Working media + production budget as a band in EUR. A band, never the figure.

source.description: Locator only. The quote would carry the figure.

in_market.description: [gate: none] In-market window. Drives the rhythm-and-moments lens.

channels_mandated.description: [gate: none] Channels the client requires, as slugs (tv, bvod, ooh, social_meta, audio, in_store...).

deliverables.description: [gate: none] What the agency must hand over, as slugs (tvc_30, social_cutdowns, ooh_48sheet...).

constraints.description: [gate: none] Legal, brand and mandatory constraints.

ask_source.description: [gate: created] The client's own brief or email, by hash. The source of record for every extracted field.

selection.description: Region C: what research drew on, what it looked for and did not find, and what clashed.

lenses_run.description: One entry per lens x market run. Address key: <lens>/<market>.

coverage.description: Merged coverage per lens across markets. filled = corroborated, thin = single-source, empty = nothing found. Merged: filled only if filled in every market, empty only if empty in every market, otherwise thin.

coverage_by_market.description: The per-market coverage the merged map was computed from.

gaps.description: What was looked for and not found. Address key: id.

key.description: <entity>:<fact key>, the fact that was wanted.

searched.description: What was looked for, in words.

contested.description: Two writers, one fact identity, different values. Resolved entries stay; the losing values stay with the written reason. Must hold no open entry at lock. Address key: id.

from.description: Which writer produced it: <lens>/<market>, a source id, or an actor.

excluded.description: Facts research found and deliberately did not pin. Address key: fact_id.

lenses_skipped.description: Lenses the select stage judged not relevant to this ask, with why. Skipped is not empty: a skipped lens x market has no lenses_run entry and no coverage. market absent: skipped in every market. Address key: <lens>/<market>, or <lens> when market is absent.

materials.description: Supplied material, keyed by material id: the prompt and every attachment. Bytes live as assets by hash; this is the index spans cite.

asset.description: Asset path inside the document, when the bytes travel in it.

licence.description: Facts derived from client-confidential material carry the brand licence class and never promote (C3).

intake.description: The chat that started the campaign. messages is a MAP keyed by message id, never an array: two writers (the person through the view, the middleware through its data_patch) each add keys, and a JSON merge patch merges objects key-wise, so neither write replaces the other and no stale-base collision arises. Display order: at, then key.

report.description: WRITTEN BY THE MIDDLEWARE ONLY (the report stage of start_campaign, or compose_report), replaced whole on every write; the view renders it read-only and no human patch writes it. Structured blocks, never HTML. Every claim cites pins or findings that exist in the document; nothing cites a rejected finding.

based_on.description: The document the report was composed from: its clan.version and the host's member hashes (projection.built_from) as read. The view flags the report out of date when these hashes differ from projection.built_from, or a campaign or selection decision is newer than built_at.

confirm.description: D3's short confirmation list: the subject brand, categories, markets and comparators while any is not yet confirmed or stated, then every other proposed field. Non-blocking; the chat only blocks on what identify cannot decide.

not_researched.description: Every lens x market that was not researched and why — at least every selection.lenses_skipped entry, with its reason.

projection.description: HOST-WRITTEN, READ-ONLY (decision D2). A scalar projection of shared/facts.yaml and shared/findings.yaml so view bindings resolve against shared/data.yaml alone. Rebuilt by the host after every change to either member; no agent or human patch may write it; the members are the authority. If built_from does not match the members' hashes the view says so instead of rendering the projection as current.

items.description: Source ids, a human:<id> verification, or — for method: synthesis — the fact ids it rests on

status.description: The layer row's status when pinned. Frozen with the value.

current_value.description: For a stale pin only: the value of the current layer version, offered, never swapped in.
